items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact status label with solid, muted, and dot variants for tagging content inline.

items.name: clipboard-field
items.title: Clipboard Field
items.description: A one-click install/copy field that morphs between the command and a success label using CSS grid fr tracks — JS only copies and toggles state.

items.name: fader
items.title: Fader
items.description: A mixing-console-style parameter fader where the control IS the display, with continuous and detent value grammars, elastic overdrag, and spring-animated settle.

items.name: bounce-sidebar
items.title: Bounce Sidebar
items.description: A sidebar navigation with a bouncing dot indicator that smoothly animates between items using spring physics.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A blossom-style color picker with concentric petal layers, circular color bar, and arc slider for lightness control.

items.name: goo-dropdown
items.title: Gooey Dropdown
items.description: A dropdown menu with a gooey SVG filter effect that morphs a trigger pill into the panel using spring physics and CSS shape interpolation.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password input with an animated eye toggle that follows your cursor and blinks periodically.

items.name: ratio-slider
items.title: Ratio Slider
items.description: A split ratio slider with two color bars, a draggable divider, and responsive labels that collapse when space is tight.

items.name: scroll-indicator
items.title: Scroll Indicator
items.description: A vertical scroll progress indicator with tick marks, section labels, and a floating position readout.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: A fixed bottom-left floating block that tracks scroll position, shows the active section, and expands into a navigable section list.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A horizontal trail of links that auto-collapses into an ellipsis button when the trail exceeds maxItems.

items.name: mobile-drawer
items.title: Mobile Drawer
items.description: A bottom-sheet drawer with swipe-to-dismiss, focus trap, and scroll lock.

items.name: morph-nav
items.title: Morph Nav
items.description: A floating action button that morphs through states with SVG path-morphing trigger icon.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu with proximity highlight and keyboard navigation.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A filterable select with live search, proximity highlight, and native select mirror for forms.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with drawn check animation, indeterminate state, and hidden native input for forms.

items.name: icon-bar
items.title: Icon Bar
items.description: A horizontal toolbar of icon buttons with bloom-open label reveal on hover/selection, accent dot indicator, and roving tabindex.

items.name: id-reel
items.title: Id Reel
items.description: An id pill with an odometer run-up on its digits, middle-truncation for long values, and an optional GitHub-style pull-request status badge.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: The text field foundation with adornments, size variants, and animated focus ring.

items.name: nav-menu
items.title: Nav Menu
items.description: A vertical navigation list with two-layer proximity highlight (active route + hover), weight-shift labels, and status dots for new/updated items.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A popover action menu with a proximity-driven morphing highlight. The muted hover highlight springs between items as the pointer moves, giving the menu a fluid, alive feel.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A form select with a two-layer proximity highlight (selected accent tint + muted hover), drawn check animation, and a trigger label morph on selection change.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A radio group with roving tabindex and a dot morph selection indicator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle switch with thumb travel animation and hidden checkbox for forms.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A composable data table with semantic markup and a per-row hover highlight that dims into the active row.

items.name: tabs-subtle
items.title: Tabs Subtle
items.description: A pill-style tab list where the selected indicator springs between tabs, built on the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with full roving-focus keyboard support.
